title: Workload workload.yaml (LIB-0023, LIB-0028, LIB-0029, LIB-0030, LIB-0033, LIB-0037, LIB-0038, LIB-0039, LIB-0043)

name.description: What the workload's own resources carry in their names. Default: its directory (LIB-0037 §1)

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

organization_id.description: Organization ID for the project — defaults to the provider's own; changing this recreates the resource

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

ssh_key.description: SSH key to register for instance access in this project — omit to skip creating one

project.description: Setting name, prefix or suffix gives the workload its own project; otherwise it lives in its zone's, and prefix and suffix are the zone's (LIB-0037 §2)

githubPages.description: The site its host serves, deployed by the Pages shim <username>/<shim>. Implies the host's Pages CNAMEs, which an entry of the same key overrides field by field (LIB-0037 §4)

shim.description: Default: the host as a domain, the zone for @

deployer.description: The unit's deployer: an IAM application, its policy on the unit's project and its API key, each at the instance deployer (LIB-0038 §1)

cockpit.description: Cockpit for the workload's project. Every instance ships to it unless it sets cockpit: false

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

enabled.description: false destroys the network and keeps its settings here. Default: true

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

enable_masquerade.description: NAT the Private Network's outbound traffic through the gateway's IP

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)
A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

push_default_route.description: Advertise the gateway as the Private Network's default route. While it does, an attached instance's own public IP is reachable outbound only (ADR-0146).

type.description: Default: VPC-GW-S. Only ever upgraded in place

enabled.description: false destroys the gateway and keeps its settings here; every instance must then set network.publicIpv4: true. Default: true

publicGateway.description: The workload's one Public Gateway, egress and SSH for instances on the private network (LIB-0043 §5)

instance.description: Each <key> is a compute-instance and its compute-instance-config, and with selfDelete its own IAM application, policy and key (LIB-0043 §§2-3)

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

enabled.description: Whether to create the instance. false destroys the server only; any IP, volume or IAM the caller created for it is untouched.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

image.description: Instance image label (e.g. ubuntu_jammy, ubuntu_noble, ubuntu_resolute)

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)
A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)
A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

ssh_key.description: Public SSH key to authorize on the instance, passed through as an AUTHORIZED_KEY tag. Exactly one key, not a list (ADR-0118).

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

privateNetwork.description: Attach a NIC on the private network. Default: whether scaleway.privateNetwork is on

publicIpv4.description: Give it a routed IPv4. With the gateway on and the instance on the network, the IP is outbound-only while the gateway pushes its default route. Default: false

sshViaGateway.description: The gateway port forwarded to its port 22; unique across instances

cockpit.description: Ship metrics and logs to scaleway.cockpit. Default: whether it is declared

transcoding.description: Install transcoding tools; x86_64 types only

selfDelete.description: Delete the instance once its commands exit, with its own application, policy and key. Default: false

sharedKeyring.description: Merged under every instance's keyring, which wins on a shared alias

keyring.description: Credentials cloud-init writes for the instance, by alias. A command names one as ${keyring.<alias>.alias} (LIB-0043 §4)

bucket.description: A scaleway.bucket key, whose name and endpoint are wired, or the name of a bucket elsewhere, which then needs endpoint

apiKey.description: A scaleway.iam.apiKey key, whose credentials are wired
